Variants.Content: Pyke is located in the western Iron Islands and is the ancestral home of House Greyjoy. Pyke is built on a promontory that has been eroded by the sea into several stone pillars, with a drawbridge connecting the towers; it is the political core of the Iron Islands, with the longship port, the tradition of the Drowned God and the Salt Throne jointly supporting Greyjoy's authority.

Entry Island of Pyke Local families also relied on salt fish, ore, barren fields, sheltered anchorages, and longships to return home; if any road, well, or dock failed, the price would fall first on them.

Entry Island of Pyke They will also recognize the accents, laws and credentials of the Iron Islands; reputations may travel great distances from taverns, but true distances must still be measured by wheel, oar or horse's hoof.
Entry Island of Pyke Entry Island of Pyke

Entry Island of Pyke If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.
Entry Island of Pyke A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Island of Pyke They care about salt fish, ore, barren fields, sheltered anchorages, and the return of longships. They also look at whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
